components.name: Brand Signature
components.description: The only product branding: a generated transparent wordmark in one compact 40px row.
components.css: .ds-brand { width: 390px; max-width: 100%; height: 40px; display: grid; place-items: center; overflow: hidden; background: #3c3022; } .ds-brand img { width: auto; max-width: min(250px, calc(100vw - 32px)); height: auto; max-height: 30px; object-fit: contain; }

components.name: View Switch
components.description: The centered two-option control that is the app's entire visible navigation.
components.css: .ds-switch { width: 196px; height: 34px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #a88b55; border-radius: 4px; background: #493c2b; } .ds-switch-option { min-height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-right: 1px solid #a88b55; background: transparent; color: #f6e6bd; font: 700 13px/1.15 Merriweather, Georgia, serif; } .ds-switch-option:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-switch-option:hover { background: #5b4a34; } .ds-switch-option:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f0d699; outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-switch-option:active, .ds-switch-active { background: #d8bd88; color: #171009; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 0 #efe0b3, inset 0 -2px 0 #8a6935; }

components.name: Contextual Edit Action
components.description: The right-track pencil that becomes save and cancel only while editing the selected view.
components.css: .ds-icon-action { width: 44px; height: 44px; display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 0; border: 0; border-left: 1px solid rgb(221 192 126 / 28%); border-radius: 0; background: #3c3022; color: #f6e6bd; } .ds-icon-action img { display: block; filter: invert(93%) sepia(24%) saturate(530%) hue-rotate(347deg) brightness(105%); } .ds-icon-action:hover, .ds-icon-action:active { background: #5b4a34; } .ds-icon-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f0d699; outline-offset: -3px; }

components.name: Fixed Rivalry Score

components.html: 2–0

components.css: .ds-matrix { display: flex; width: 276px; color: #171009; font-family: Merriweather, Georgia, serif; } .ds-rail { width: 44px; flex: 0 0 44px; display: grid; grid-template-rows: 34px 108px 108px 38px; background: #3c3022; } .ds-rail i { border-block: 1px solid #3b2814; } .ds-rail strong { display: grid; place-items: center; overflow: hidden; color: #fff8e8; font-size: 13px; text-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 50%); writing-mode: vertical-rl; transform: rotate(180deg); } .ds-rail-blue { background: #174766; box-shadow: inset 0 -3px 0 #5c4326; } .ds-rail-red { background: #6f2018; } .ds-rail-result { display: grid; place-items: center; } .ds-rail-result img { width: 20px; height: 20px; filter: invert(70%) sepia(54%) saturate(623%) hue-rotate(2deg) brightness(91%); } .ds-week { width: 232px; border-right: 1px solid #3b2814; background: #c7a86f; } .ds-week time { height: 34px; display: grid; place-items: center; background: #72604a; color: #fff8e7; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-team-blue { box-shadow: inset 0 -3px 0 #5c4326; } .ds-player { height: 54px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 38px minmax(0,1fr); align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 4px 7px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(59 40 20 / 54%); background: rgb(229 205 157 / 55%); } .ds-player img { width: 38px; height: 38px; object-fit: contain; } .ds-player span, .ds-player b, .ds-player small { min-width: 0; display: block; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-player b { font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.15; } .ds-player small { color: #4d3617; font-size: 10.5px; line-height: 1.15; } .ds-result { height: 38px; display: grid; place-items: center; background: #174766; color: #fff8e7; font-size: 11px; }

components.name: Inline Match Selects
components.description: Two stacked native selectors replace public copy inside the unchanged 54px player row.
components.css: .ds-edit-player { width: 232px; height: 54px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 34px minmax(0,1fr); grid-template-rows: 23px 23px; align-items: center; gap: 0 6px; padding: 3px 6px; background: rgb(229 205 157 / 55%); } .ds-edit-player img { grid-row: 1 / 3; width: 34px; height: 34px; object-fit: contain; } .ds-edit-player select { width: 100%; min-width: 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(59 40 20 / 68%); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: #171009; font: 400 10.5px/1 Merriweather, Georgia, serif; } .ds-edit-player select:hover { background: rgb(216 189 136 / 42%); } .ds-edit-player select:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f0d699; outline-offset: -3px; }

components.name: Standings Table

components.css: .ds-stats { width: 390px; max-width: 100%; table-layout: fixed; border-collapse: collapse; background: rgb(216 189 136 / 72%); color: #171009; font: 400 12px/1.3 Merriweather, Georgia, serif; } .ds-stats thead { background: #3c3022; color: #fff3d6; } .ds-stats th, .ds-stats td { height: 44px; padding: 0 7px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(59 40 20 / 56%); text-align: center; } .ds-stats th:first-child, .ds-stats td:first-child { width: 38px; } .ds-stats th:nth-child(2), .ds-stats td:nth-child(2) { overflow: hidden; text-align: left; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-stats th:nth-child(n+3):not(:last-child), .ds-stats td:nth-child(n+3):not(:last-child) { width: 36px; } .ds-stats th:last-child, .ds-stats td:last-child { width: 54px; } .ds-stats tbody tr:nth-child(even) { background: rgb(177 143 88 / 28%); }

components.css: .ds-dialog { width: min(calc(100% - 24px), 440px); display: grid; gap: 9px; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid #3b2814; border-radius: 0; background: #c7a86f; color: #171009; box-shadow: 10px 14px 34px rgb(0 0 0 / 42%); font: 400 14px/1.3 Merriweather, Georgia, serif; } .ds-dialog-heading { min-height: 44px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin: -12px -12px 0; padding-left: 12px; background: #3c3022; color: #fff3d6; } .ds-dialog-heading button, .ds-dialog-form button { min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; border: 0; border-left: 1px solid rgb(59 40 20 / 48%); border-radius: 0; background: #3c3022; color: #fff3d6; font-weight: 700; } .ds-dialog-heading img { display: block; margin: auto; filter: invert(93%) sepia(24%) saturate(530%) hue-rotate(347deg) brightness(105%); } .ds-dialog-form { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) auto; } .ds-dialog-form input { min-width: 0; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: rgb(239 219 177 / 76%); color: #171009; } .ds-dialog button:hover { background: #5b4a34; } .ds-dialog button:focus-visible, .ds-dialog input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f0d699; outline-offset: -3px; }

narrative.overview: The product is one compact, hand-kept AoE2 competition sheet translated directly to a phone. Brown furniture frames a continuous parchment surface; one compact heraldic signature, a fixed blue–red score, and one horizontally moving 4v4 matrix carry the entire match story. The interface removes product theater and dashboard hierarchy. A 40px generated `Bu Ecof Empires` signature is the only branding; there is no introductory copy, hero, sidebar, footer, floating menu, bottom navigation, archive surface, or repeated match data. The next row contains only the centered `Maçlar | Sıralama` switch and contextual actions. The exact team names `Cortinyanlar` and `Bakracoğulları` remain visible in the matrix rails and editing controls.
keyCharacteristics: one newest-first horizontal match matrix, with every match represented once;
a complete 4v4 match visible inside the first 390 × 844 viewport;
one compact generated wordmark above the controls, never a promotional header;
fixed Cortinyanlar blue and Bakracoğulları red, paired with vertical named rails;
Merriweather over a continuous local parchment texture with brown furniture, thin bronze rules, a walnut team divider, and one winner medal;
contextual editing that changes only the currently selected surface.

rules.name: The Fixed Rivalry Rule
rules.body: Cortinyanlar stays blue and Bakracoğulları stays red. Do not swap, theme, randomize, or introduce a third team color.

rules.name: The Named Rail Rule
rules.body: Team color never carries identity by itself: the exact team names remain legible in the vertical rails, winner value, or accessible score labels.

rules.name: The Bronze Is Structure Rule
rules.body: Bronze draws boundaries and selection detail; it never becomes a gradient, glow, or decorative wash.

rules.name: The One-Voice Rule
rules.body: Do not reintroduce Alegreya, a sans-serif UI family, blackletter, novelty runes, an icon font, or monospace display copy.

rules.name: The Signature Exception Rule
rules.body: The generated wordmark may precede controls in one 40px row. It cannot gain subtitle copy, promotional scale, extra chrome, or a second title.

rules.name: The One Scroll Owner Rule
rules.body: The document stays viewport-bound in public match view; only the match matrix owns horizontal movement.

rules.name: The Show It Once Rule
rules.body: Every match appears once, newest first. Do not split history into latest, recent, and archive variants.

rules.name: The Phone Is Canonical Rule
rules.body: Any new state must preserve the complete first match at 390 × 844 before wider behavior is considered.

rules.name: The Flat Record Rule
rules.body: If a surface remains in document flow, separate it with tone or a 1px rule. Elevation belongs only to temporary overlays.

rules.name: The Segmented Exception Rule
rules.body: A small radius may bind a single mutually exclusive control; it does not license rounded containers elsewhere.

dos: **Do** keep branding limited to the 40px generated signature and keep the next row limited to the centered `Maçlar | Sıralama` switch and contextual edit actions.
**Do** preserve the 44/232/34/54/38px phone matrix geometry and verify the first complete match at 390 × 844.
**Do** keep Cortinyanlar blue and Bakracoğulları red, with exact names visible or available to assistive technology.
**Do** show every match once, newest first, in the one horizontal matrix.
**Do** keep `# / Oyuncu / O / G / M / %` intact at every supported width.
**Do** preserve 44px touch targets, visible focus, reduced motion, native scrolling, and top safe-area padding.
**Do** use and license local parchment, Merriweather, interface icons, and civilization crests.
donts: **Don't** expand the signature into a promotional header, subtitle, hero, footer, sidebar, floating menu, bottom navigation, or dashboard cards.
**Don't** duplicate match data as latest, recent, archive, highlights, or summaries.
**Don't** add P1–P4 labels, repeated team headings, or a second horizontal scroll owner.
**Don't** switch the matrix to cards or hide player civilizations on narrow screens.
**Don't** bring back orange, green, or configurable team colors; the rivalry is fixed blue and red.
**Don't** add gradients, glass, decorative glows, giant crests, full ornamental frames, or texture overlays beyond the real parchment asset.
**Don't** add a floating save control, persistent bottom action, PIN, login, user token, or stale-conflict warning.
**Don't** introduce another font, hotlinked asset, emoji action icon, or rasterized interface text.
